pictures.name: CPS1-Shepherd-Boy
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Rolling golden hills near Bethlehem in ancient Israel at late afternoon, a flock of sheep grazing among rocks and olive trees. In the middle, the young shepherd David, a slim youth with reddish-brown curly hair in a simple undyed wool tunic, always seen only from behind or far away, his face never visible, sits on a rock seen from behind, looking out over the valley, playing a small wooden lyre with gut strings, a shepherd’s staff and sling beside him. Warm gold light, deep blue shadows in the valley. Peace, music, solitude. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CPS2-Troubled-King
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A dim royal chamber in an ancient Israelite palace, heavy cedar beams, woven hangings. In the middle, King Saul, a tall powerful man with a dark grey beard, in a purple robe and a gold circlet, his face heavy with sorrow, sits slumped on a carved wooden throne, head in one hand, staring into darkness, a spear leaning on the wall. Two worried servants whisper in the doorway. One small oil lamp gives gold light, deep blue shadows fill the room. Heaviness, sorrow. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CPS3-David-Plays
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The same royal chamber, now softly lit. In the foreground, the young shepherd David, a slim youth with reddish-brown curly hair in a simple undyed wool tunic, always seen only from behind or far away, his face never visible, sits on a low stool seen from behind, playing the small wooden lyre. Across from him, in the middle of the picture, King Saul, a tall powerful man with a dark grey beard, in a purple robe and a gold circlet, his face heavy with sorrow, leans back on his throne, eyes closed, his face easing into peace. Warm gold lamplight spreading, deep blue shadows retreating. Healing, calm, music. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CPS4-Songs-Of-David
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A night sky over the hills of Judea, seen from a hilltop: under a vast sky of stars, the young shepherd David, a slim youth with reddish-brown curly hair in a simple undyed wool tunic, always seen only from behind or far away, his face never visible, now a young man in a simple robe, seen far away from behind, stands with arms lifted, his lyre at his side. Around him, faint ghostly scenes in the clouds and hills suggest many moods: a sunrise, a storm, a lonely figure weeping, a dancing crowd. Deep blue night, gold starlight. Every feeling, offered up. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CPS5-Shepherd-Psalm
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A green valley with a still stream at dawn, ancient Israel. A shepherd seen only from behind, his face not visible, in a brown cloak with a staff, leads his flock beside the quiet water; one small lamb rests in his arm. Soft mist, green grass, warm gold first light, deep blue shadows on the hills. Trust, rest, safety. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CPS6-Today-Monks-Chant
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A modern Benedictine abbey church at evening, painted in the same sacred oil style: two rows of monks in black habits face each other in wooden choir stalls, singing from open books, candles glowing; in the side pews a few ordinary visitors in modern coats sit listening, one young woman with eyes closed. Warm gold candlelight, deep blue shadows under the stone arches. Peace, rhythm, prayer. No text, no letters, no logos.
